snippet.title: Soundwave Teaser (2)
snippet.description:
Soundwave is a frequency memory game that tests your ear like nothing else. A tone plays. Then silence. Your job is to recreate it from memory using a scrolling piano keyboard — scored on accuracy across 5 rounds.
Sounds simple. It is not simple.
🎮 Features:

Ranked Play — 5 rounds, scored out of 75, global leaderboard
Chord Mode — identify root note and quality by ear
Daily Challenge — same tones for everyone, one shot
Versus Mode — real-time 1v1 with SR ranking (Bronze → Legend)
34 Steam achievements
4 sound themes
7 languages
Easy + Hard difficulty

Developed by jelly & dxxthly — Mantle Software
🔗 Play on Steam: http://www.mantlesoftware.net
